ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, $\angle BAC=54^\circ$. The circle $\odot O$ with diameter $AB$ intersects $AC$ and $BC$ at points $D$ and $E$, respectively. A tangent line to $\odot O$ passing through point $B$ intersects the extension of $AC$ at point $F$. Given $AB=6$, what is the length of $\overset{\frown}{AD}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw line OD, \\
since $OA = OD$, $\angle BAC = 54^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle BOD = 72^\circ$, $\angle AOD = 72^\circ$. \\
Also, since $AB = 6$, \\
therefore $OA = 3$. \\
Therefore, $\overset{\frown}{AD} = \frac{72\pi \times 3}{180} = \boxed{\frac{6\pi }{5}}$.
